name: npc_ronin-wanderer-01
customDialogue:
I walked away from every village once.
The road always brings me back here.

name: npc_ronin-sensei-01
customDialogue:
...
The Silent Ronin only nods toward the dojo, then looks back at you.

name: npc_ronin-archivist-01
customDialogue:
Every scroll here was written by someone who chose to stay.
Read carefully. The Ronin never write twice.

name: npc_ronin-strategist-01
customDialogue:
The fortress was built to keep something in, not to keep enemies out.
Few remember that.

spotConfig.label: Inspect the red dust
spotConfig.text: An old root breaks the ground here. Red dust rises from the crack beneath it.

spotConfig.label: Inspect the red dust
spotConfig.text: More red dust, fine as ash, pooled where a root meets the cliff.

spotConfig.label: Inspect the red dust
spotConfig.text: Outside the wall the dust is thicker. It is rising, not falling.

spotConfig.label: Read the old marker
spotConfig.text: Carved in stone: THE RONIN KEEP THE DOOR SHUT. THE DEBT IS PAID IN SILENCE.

spotConfig.label: Look at the mark
spotConfig.text: A small sword mark, scratched low on the stone. It points east.

spotConfig.label: Look at the mark
spotConfig.text: Another sword mark. This one points back toward the bonsai.

spotConfig.label: Look at the mark
spotConfig.text: The last mark is fresh. Whoever made it was here tonight.

spotConfig.label: Sit by the fire
spotConfig.text: The fire crackles. Somewhere in the dark, someone hums an old Ronin song.

spotConfig.label: Look at the trunk
spotConfig.text: Pressed into the bonsai trunk, a red handprint. The bark around it is still warm.

spotConfig.label: Wait in silence
spotConfig.text: Thirty breaths of silence. Somewhere behind you, a Ronin nods.

spotConfig.label: Touch the stone
spotConfig.text: Behind the dojo the fortress wall is not a wall. It is a door, sealed with the red hand.
In the fog the causeway seems endless, and for a moment you hear footsteps that are not yours.

spotConfig.label: Light the lantern
spotConfig.text: The crimson lantern catches. For a moment every pillar on the causeway flickers with it.

spotConfig.label: Look closer
spotConfig.text: A tiny ant peeks out at you.
